errors.evidence: The description states the vertical axis scale is from 0 to 80, but the chart includes negative values, as seen for the chLSTM model at positions L₃, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺.

errors.text_span: The shortest bar, associated with chLSTM at position L₄⁺,
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the shortest bar. The bar with the lowest value (most negative) is for chLSTM at position R₂, with a value around -1.5. The chLSTM bar at L₄⁺ has a positive value of approximately 1.
The value for the chLSTM bar at position L₄⁺ is approximately 1, not 3. The actual shortest bar (chLSTM at R₂) has a value of approximately -1.5.

errors.text_span: the tallest bar, corresponding to mBERT at position T,
errors.evidence: The tallest bar in the chart corresponds to chLSTM at position T, with a value of approximately 79. The description incorrectly identifies the mBERT bar at this position as the tallest.
The value for the mBERT bar at position T is approximately 59, not 78. The actual tallest bar in the chart (chLSTM at T) has a value of approximately 79.

errors.text_span: Generally, the chLSTM bars are consistently shorter than the other two models.
errors.evidence: This statement is an interpretation and is also factually incorrect. The single tallest bar in the entire chart belongs to the chLSTM model (at position T).

errors.text_span: Some bars are visually emphasized with a darker shade of the respective color.
errors.evidence: There is no visual emphasis on any bars using darker shades. The different colors (light blue, dark blue, light green) simply correspond to the three different models as defined in the legend.
